item.name: Story Mode
item.cardSummary: The main campaign route for clearing themed stages, earning basic resources, and preparing a team for harder modes.
item.accessLocation: Select Story Mode from the lobby stage selector.
item.restrictions: Uses the selected stage's map and enemy roster.
item.specialRules: Each stage has its own map and rewards; later progression follows campaign clears.
item.rotationOrReset: Permanent mode; stage content changes with game updates.

item.name: Legend Stages
item.cardSummary: Harder versions of selected campaign stages that add stronger enemies, modifiers, and exclusive progression rewards.
item.purpose: Advanced campaign farming and challenge progression
item.accessLocation: Open Legend Stages from the stage selector after the relevant Story progression.
item.restrictions: Stronger enemies and stage modifiers can change the normal campaign approach.
item.specialRules: Legend variants use exclusive reward paths and increase the value of advanced farming.
item.rotationOrReset: Permanent mode; available stages follow game updates.

item.name: Challenge Mode
item.cardSummary: Rotating Story and Legend runs with extra modifiers for repeatable challenge rewards on regular, daily, and weekly schedules.
item.purpose: Modifier-based farming and repeatable challenge rewards
item.accessLocation: Open Challenge Mode from the lobby stage area.
item.wavesOrFloors: Story or Legend stages with added modifiers
item.restrictions: Challenge modifiers can restrict units or alter enemies.
item.specialRules: Regular, daily, and weekly slots use different refresh cadences; a completion cap can apply.
item.rotationOrReset: Regular slots refresh every 30 minutes; daily slots every 24 hours; weekly slots every 7 days.

item.name: Raids
item.cardSummary: Endgame co-op encounters built around multi-wave clears, raid currencies, and exclusive upgrade materials.
item.purpose: Endgame co-op farming and upgrade progression
item.accessLocation: Enter Raids from the Raid area in the lobby.
item.unlockRequirement: Endgame access; exact account gate varies by implementation
item.restrictions: Harder waves and boss encounters require a developed team.
item.specialRules: Raid currencies can be exchanged for evolution materials, trait rerolls, and other upgrade resources.
item.rotationOrReset: Stage pool and reward focus can change with game updates.

item.name: Dungeons
item.cardSummary: Multi-wave dungeon runs that use modifier cards to change combat and offer specialized drops beyond standard stages.
item.purpose: Modifier-driven farming and specialized dungeon rewards
item.accessLocation: Enter Dungeons from the Dungeon area in the lobby.
item.unlockRequirement: Endgame access; exact gate varies by dungeon
item.wavesOrFloors: 30 waves for the documented base Dungeon; named variants can use floors.
item.restrictions: Modifier cards can buff units, strengthen enemies, or otherwise change the run.
item.specialRules: Run modifiers alter the combat route, so team planning depends on the selected cards.
item.rotationOrReset: Named dungeon content and reward tables may be update-specific.

item.name: Boss Rush / Boss Events
item.cardSummary: Rotating boss encounters that turn weekly clears into a focused source of tokens, trophies, and boss-specific rewards.
item.purpose: Boss farming and rotating event progression
item.accessLocation: Open the active Boss Rush or Boss Event from the lobby.
item.unlockRequirement: Endgame or event access, depending on the active boss
item.wavesOrFloors: Boss-heavy waves; documented runs use 30 waves.
item.restrictions: Traits can be disabled in Boss Rush variants.
item.specialRules: The boss roster and reward shop rotate separately from the durable mode family.

item.name: Portals
item.cardSummary: Tiered encounters with element-themed enemy pools, escalating difficulty, and exclusive drops for coordinated teams.
item.purpose: Tiered farming for exclusive drops and materials
item.accessLocation: Enter Portals from the Portals area in the lobby.
item.unlockRequirement: Portal access after progression; exact gate varies by portal
item.restrictions: Enemy elements and portal-specific rules can shape the required team.
item.specialRules: Higher tiers increase challenge and change the quality of the reward pool.
item.rotationOrReset: Portal pool and reward focus can change with game updates.

item.name: Sandbox
item.cardSummary: A testing space for experimenting with units, enemies, stats, and money without normal campaign pressure.
item.accessLocation: Choose Sandbox from the stage selector.
item.restrictions: Sandbox runs do not provide normal account progression rewards.
item.specialRules: Players can use units, spawn enemies, adjust stats, and use unlimited in-run money to test setups.
item.rotationOrReset: Permanent utility mode; testing controls may change with updates.

item.name: Rifts
item.cardSummary: Co-op encounters centered on global tasks, rare rewards, and a larger party format than ordinary stage runs.
item.purpose: Co-op rare-drop farming and update progression
item.accessLocation: Enter Rifts from the Rift area in the lobby.
item.unlockRequirement: Progression access; exact gate varies by Rift
item.wavesOrFloors: Encounter waves; exact count varies by Rift.
item.restrictions: Rift-specific enemies and reward windows can change the team plan.
item.specialRules: Global tasks can affect how quickly Rifts appear and how the encounter is pursued.
item.rotationOrReset: Encounter pool and reward focus rotate with updates.

item.name: Odyssey
item.cardSummary: An escalating run mode with route choices, cards, powers, and mastery goals that reward adapting between encounters.
item.purpose: Long-form run progression and mastery objectives
item.accessLocation: Open Odyssey from the lobby mode selector.
item.restrictions: Run-specific powers, cards, and modifiers change what a team can do.
item.specialRules: Reworked routes use longer challenge paths, card storage or loadouts, and modifier choices between encounters.
item.rotationOrReset: Some objectives and rewards can change with updates.

item.name: Infinite Mode
item.cardSummary: An endless version of an unlocked stage where surviving more waves increases the endurance challenge and reward potential.
item.purpose: Endless survival, score chasing, and wave-scaled farming
item.accessLocation: Choose the Infinite option for an unlocked stage.
item.unlockRequirement: Complete every Normal act for the relevant Story stage
item.restrictions: There is no fixed final wave; the run continues until the defense fails or the player stops.
item.specialRules: Reward and challenge progress scale with the waves reached.
item.rotationOrReset: Stage availability follows unlocked Story stages.

item.name: Elemental Towers
item.cardSummary: Permanent element-locked towers where matching units climb floors for repeatable rewards and a distinct team-building challenge.
item.purpose: Element-focused endurance progression and reward farming
item.accessLocation: Enter from the Elemental Towers area near the Dungeon in the Raid area.
item.wavesOrFloors: 20 waves per floor; reward loop noted after Floor 50
item.restrictions: Only matching-element units can be placed; farm units are exempt and the Omni Tower is unrestricted.
item.specialRules: Each tower has its own reward path, and co-op does not increase enemy scaling.
item.rotationOrReset: Permanent mode; reward depth and tower details can change with updates.

item.name: PvP
item.cardSummary: The competitive wave mode family with Assault, Defense, and Ranked variants plus trait and modifier choices.
item.accessLocation: Open PvP from the lobby competitive area.
item.restrictions: Traited and traitless variants change the available build options; a modifier is applied every five waves.
item.specialRules: Players must outlast the opposing player while adapting to the shared wave modifiers.
item.rotationOrReset: Ranked and seasonal reward rules can change.

item.name: Gauntlets
item.cardSummary: A bracket PvP mode where players advance on score, with standard eight-player brackets and configurable custom lobbies.
item.purpose: Bracket placement and competitive score chasing
item.accessLocation: Open Gauntlets from the PvP or competitive area.
item.partySize: 8-player standard bracket; custom brackets support 2 to 64 players
item.wavesOrFloors: Round-based scoring; a standard round lasts 24 hours.
item.restrictions: Standard brackets give three tries per round; the highest score advances.
item.specialRules: Up to five standard brackets can run at once. Custom hosts can set maps, modifiers, mutators, banned or buffed units, and elements.
item.rotationOrReset: Standard bracket timing is round-based; the reward pool can rotate weekly.

item.name: Worldlines
item.cardSummary: A solo floor climb that moves from Worlds Collide into Infinite Convergence as the run passes the initial milestone floors.
item.purpose: Solo endurance progression and leaderboard competition
item.accessLocation: Open Worldlines from the competitive area.
item.unlockRequirement: Worldlines progression; exact account gate not listed
item.restrictions: Floor-specific stage challenges and reward resets shape the climb.
item.specialRules: Milestone rewards arrive during the floor climb; later floors use Infinite Convergence rules.
item.rotationOrReset: Reward path resets by season or update.

item.name: Tournaments
item.cardSummary: A weekly solo competition built around damage and kill objectives, resettable placement, and rotating rewards.
item.purpose: Weekly score competition and leaderboard placement
item.accessLocation: Open Tournaments from the competitive area.
item.restrictions: Stage and element rules can change with the tournament.
item.specialRules: Players compete for placement on leaderboards that reset on the tournament schedule.
rewards: Rotating cosmetics or units where listed
